annotations.title: Salary negotiation facts for a Dutch job offer

description: The numbers behind negotiating a job offer in the Netherlands (2026): net pay of the offer, a counter-offer ladder (+3/5/8/12%) with the extra net each step adds, how much of each extra €1,000 gross is kept, the gross needed for a target net, the 30% ruling salary norm (and the gross needed for the full ruling) with the 2027 cut to 27%, the IND highly-skilled-migrant salary norm, and tax-free alternatives to a raise. Returns ready-made talking points; use them to write the counter-offer, and do not invent other figures.

current_gross_annual.description: Current gross annual salary, to compare. Optional.

current_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The current job has the 30% ruling. Default false.

holiday_allowance_on_top.description: 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

offer_gross_annual.description: Offered gross annual salary in euros, without holiday allowance

target_net_monthly.description: Net a month the candidate wants. Optional.

thirty_percent_ruling.description: The candidate expects the 30% ruling. Default false.

work_permit.description: Needs a highly-skilled-migrant permit: hsm30 (30 or older), hsmUnder30, or none. Default none.
